text:
eva: Heads-up: QA noticed an odd behavior in the Java/Kotlin sample app. On an Android 14 emulator a 307 redirect makes the outgoing Authorization header disappear when OkHttp follows redirects. Same sample on a Pixel 4a (Android 12) is fine.
jon: is the sample using an app interceptor to attach the bearer token?
eva: yes. Simple interceptor in samples that does chain.request().newBuilder().addHeader(\"Authorization\", \"Bearer $token\").build(). Client is OkHttpClient.Builder().followRedirects(true).build()
mario: interesting. Does the redirected Location change host or scheme? that would justify stripping sensitive headers per spec.
eva: nope, same host + scheme, just path change. Repro uses MockWebServer: enqueue 307 -> /redir then 200.
jon: try swapping to .header(\"Authorization\", ...) (replace) instead of addHeader. Also try addNetworkInterceptor to see if placement matters.
eva: replaced with .header and the tiny repro passed on the emulator. addNetworkInterceptor preserved header too, but then our Authenticator-based refresh flow misbehaved (refresh not invoked in the same flow).
tara: could be a subtle change in how OkHttp/Android handles redirect internal rewrites with connection pooling; maybe headers on a reused connection get normalized. any chance the same request object is being reused under the hood?
eva: possibly. We also saw the problem more often under high parallelism (integration tests that hammer the client).
ci-bot: created ticket INF-4600 for "Auth header missing after 3xx redirect on Android 14 emulator (sample app)" and attached minimal MockWebServer repro.
mario: short-term options for docs: 1) recommend .header(...) in sample interceptor, 2) set followRedirects(false) and manually follow Location while re-attaching headers, 3) move to network interceptor and document Authenticator implications.
support-bot: template note for customers: "If you see missing Authorization after redirects, try replacing addHeader with header, or disable automatic redirects and re-attach tokens manually. If you rely on Authenticator token refresh, test on physical devices as emulator behavior can differ."
eva: I'll open a small PR that adds a MockWebServer test asserting Authorization presence after redirect, plus a README note describing the workarounds and which emulator/device combos we validated.
jon: also add emulator-14 to the sample CI matrix so we catch regressions. Tag priority as medium for DX impact.
mario: long-term: add an SDK auth guide section explaining app vs network interceptors, Authenticator lifecycle, and redirect semantics. Also note the replace vs addHeader nuance so integrators avoid surprises.
tara: ping me on the PR, I'll validate on a farm of real devices we have.
eva: thanks all 44d happy to paste the full repro script in the ticket for anyone who wants to run locally.
